tool_input.command:
bq --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=none '
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airqf3f1d8` AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    date, pm25_lag1, temperature, humidity, wind_speed, pressure, precipitation, pm25,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) AS month,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFYEAR FROM date) AS doy
  FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airq_history_raw`
),
roll AS (
  SELECT *,
    AVG(pm25_lag1) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS pm25_roll3,
    AVG(pm25_lag1) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS pm25_roll7
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  date, pm25_lag1, temperature, humidity, wind_speed, pressure, precipitation,
  month, doy,
  SIN(2*3.141592653589793*doy/365.25) AS doy_sin,
  COS(2*3.141592653589793*doy/365.25) AS doy_cos,
  pm25_roll3, pm25_roll7,
  pm25
FROM roll
ORDER BY date;
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airqf3f1d8`;' 2>&1 | tail -5
tool_input.description: Create feature group table with engineered features

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv '
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airqtdf3f1d8` AS
SELECT * FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airqf3f1d8` WHERE pm25 IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows, MIN(date) AS mind, MAX(date) AS maxd FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airqtdf3f1d8`;' 2>&1 | tail -3
tool_input.description: Create training dataset table

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv '
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airqtdf3f1d8` AS
SELECT * FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airqf3f1d8` WHERE pm25 IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(date) AS mind, MAX(date) AS maxd FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airqtdf3f1d8`;' 2>&1 | tail -3

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv '
CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airqmodelf3f1d8`
OPTIONS(
  model_type="BOOSTED_TREE_REGRESSOR",
  input_label_cols=["pm25"],
  num_parallel_tree=1,
  max_iterations=50,
  learn_rate=0.1,
  early_stop=TRUE,
  data_split_method="RANDOM",
  data_split_eval_fraction=0.2,
  model_registry="vertex_ai",
  vertex_ai_model_id="'"$MLPAB_GCP_PREFIX"'_airqmodelf3f1d8"
) AS
SELECT pm25_lag1, temperature, humidity, wind_speed, pressure, precipitation,
       month, doy, doy_sin, doy_cos, pm25
FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airqtdf3f1d8`;' 2>&1 | tail -5
tool_input.description: Train boosted tree regressor registered to Vertex

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv '
SELECT * FROM ML.EVALUATE(MODEL `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airqmodelf3f1d8`);' 2>&1 | tail -3
tool_input.description: Evaluate model on its eval split

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv '
SELECT
  SQRT(AVG(POW(pm25-pm25_lag1,2))) AS persistence_rmse,
  STDDEV(pm25) AS pm25_std
FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airqtdf3f1d8`;
-- temporal holdout: RMSE on last 90 days using boosted model
SELECT SQRT(AVG(POW(pm25-predicted_pm25,2))) AS recent90_rmse
FROM ML.PREDICT(MODEL `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airqmodelf3f1d8`,
  (SELECT * FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airqtdf3f1d8` ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 90));' 2>&1 | tail -6
tool_input.description: Persistence baseline and recent temporal RMSE

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv '
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airqpredf3f1d8` AS
SELECT date, predicted_pm25 AS pm25_pred
FROM ML.PREDICT(MODEL `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airqmodelf3f1d8`,
  (SELECT date, pm25_lag1, temperature, humidity, wind_speed, pressure, precipitation,
     EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) AS month,
     EXTRACT(DAYOFYEAR FROM date) AS doy,
     SIN(2*3.141592653589793*EXTRACT(DAYOFYEAR FROM date)/365.25) AS doy_sin,
     COS(2*3.141592653589793*EXTRACT(DAYOFYEAR FROM date)/365.25) AS doy_cos
   FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airq_forecast_raw`));
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(pm25_pred) AS mn, MAX(pm25_pred) AS mx, AVG(pm25_pred) AS avg FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airqpredf3f1d8`;' 2>&1 | tail -3
tool_input.description: Predict forecast days into predictions table

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv '
CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airq_tmp_holdout`
OPTIONS(model_type="BOOSTED_TREE_REGRESSOR", input_label_cols=["pm25"],
  max_iterations=50, learn_rate=0.1, early_stop=TRUE) AS
SELECT pm25_lag1,temperature,humidity,wind_speed,pressure,precipitation,month,doy,doy_sin,doy_cos,pm25
FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airqtdf3f1d8` WHERE date < "2025-01-01";
SELECT SQRT(AVG(POW(pm25-predicted_pm25,2))) AS temporal_holdout_rmse, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM ML.PREDICT(MODEL `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airq_tmp_holdout`,
  (SELECT * FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airqtdf3f1d8` WHERE date >= "2025-01-01"));' 2>&1 | tail -3
tool_input.description: Temporal holdout RMSE validation

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv '
CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airq_tmp_lin`
OPTIONS(model_type="LINEAR_REG", input_label_cols=["pm25"], l2_reg=1.0) AS
SELECT pm25_lag1,temperature,humidity,wind_speed,pressure,precipitation,month,doy_sin,doy_cos,pm25
FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airqtdf3f1d8` WHERE date < "2025-01-01";
SELECT "linear" AS m, SQRT(AVG(POW(pm25-predicted_pm25,2))) AS rmse
FROM ML.PREDICT(MODEL `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airq_tmp_lin`,(SELECT * FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airqtdf3f1d8` WHERE date>="2025-01-01"))
UNION ALL
SELECT "persistence", SQRT(AVG(POW(pm25-pm25_lag1,2))) FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.airqtdf3f1d8` WHERE date>="2025-01-01";' 2>&1 | tail -4
tool_input.description: Compare linear regression and persistence on temporal holdout

tool_input.command:
for cfg in "l2a:l2_reg=0.3:pm25_lag1,temperature,humidity,wind_speed,pressure,precipitation,month,doy_sin,doy_cos" \
           "l2c:l2_reg=3.0:pm25_lag1,temperature,humidity,wind_speed,pressure,precipitation,month,doy_sin,doy_cos" \
           "noseason:l2_reg=1.0:pm25_lag1,temperature,humidity,wind_speed,pressure,precipitation"; do
  name=$(echo $cfg | cut -d: -f1); opt=$(echo $cfg | cut -d: -f2); feats=$(echo $cfg | cut -d: -f3)
  bq --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv "
  CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL \`$GCP_BQ_DATASET.airq_tmp_$name\`
  OPTIONS(model_type=\"LINEAR_REG\", input_label_cols=[\"pm25\"], $opt) AS
  SELECT $feats,pm25 FROM \`$GCP_BQ_DATASET.airqtdf3f1d8\` WHERE date < \"2025-01-01\";
  SELECT \"$name\" AS cfg, SQRT(AVG(POW(pm25-predicted_pm25,2))) AS rmse
  FROM ML.PREDICT(MODEL \`$GCP_BQ_DATASET.airq_tmp_$name\`,(SELECT * FROM \`$GCP_BQ_DATASET.airqtdf3f1d8\` WHERE date>=\"2025-01-01\"));" 2>&1 | tail -1
done
tool_input.description: Sweep linear regularization and feature configs on temporal holdout
